scope: The connected main hotel at the Omni Homestead Resort in Hot Springs, Virginia as documented in 2021 and 2022, including its 1902 principal block, columned entrance, brick wings and 1929 clock tower. Detached resort facilities are outside its scope.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: The landmark nomination identifies the fourteen-bay 1902 main block, double-row Ionic entrance and flanking Doric verandas, long brick wings, and staged tower with cupola.
The state historic register confirms the Colonial Revival hotel and its 1929 tower.
